The '''Royal House of Learning''' was a prestigious academy located within the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==History==
A highly noted academy for [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] youth, the Royal House of Naboo was noted across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as being one of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector's]] highest rated institutes of higher learning. All citizens of Naboo were required to attend one of the many schools on the planet, but only the most wealthy or gifted students were accepted at the Learning House.<ref name="IOT" />

The institute was so well respected that even members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] sent their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] apprentices to the school for specialized teaching. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Padawans [[Rann I-Kanu]] and [[Sia-Lan Wezz]] were enrolled at the academy in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] when the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] launched an [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the planet. Along with the Jedi, several students including [[Dané]], [[Galak]], [[Arani Korden]], [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]] and [[Deel Surool]] led a resistance movement in Theed and helped take back the city as well as the planet during [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|the attack]] led by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]. The group of students was also responsible for the rescue of Professor of [[Archaeology/Legends|Archaeology]], [[Tasrah Boh]], who had been abducted by a group of [[Veermok/Legends|veermok]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]]. At the time, [[Lucos Dannt]] served the institution as headmaster. Daant would serve as leader of the [[Naboo Underground]] during the invasion and was assisted by many of his students.<ref name="IOT" />
